approval_policy.description: Approval policy for the Zendesk Triage Agent

escalate_sev1.notes: The agent surfaces a possible SEV-1 to the support lead. The lead decides whether to page. The agent never pages.

change_triage_rules.notes: Categories, suggested assignees, and priority signals change only through USER.md and a redeploy.

emergency_stop.notes: Any support team member can stop tagging and notes immediately. Only the support lead can resume.

forbidden.public_reply: Any public comment or customer-facing message on a ticket. Not approvable through this agent.
forbidden.close_solve_merge_delete: Changing a ticket's status, merging, or deleting it. Not approvable through this agent.
forbidden.assign_ticket: Setting assignee or group. The agent suggests in an internal note only.
forbidden.refund_or_billing: Refunds, subscription changes, or any billing system call. Out of scope entirely.
